text:
SERVER_DATA
Description
For TCP, this
event
is triggered when new data is
received from the target node after
TCP::collect
command has been issued. For
UDP
, this event fires on receipt of each segment from
the server. Unlike
TCP
, no collect is required, and
there is no release command.
Examples
when
SERVER_CONNECTED
{
TCP
::
collect
}
when
SERVER_DATA
{
set
payload
[
TCP
::
payload
]
}
Related Information

- Sets the nexthop of an IP connection.

server node.

evaluated under the peer’s (opposite) context.

- Causes the system to use the named

- Returns an unused

- Returns the UDP
port/service number of a client system.

- Drops the current UDP packet

- Returns the local UDP

- Returns the content or

- Returns the remote

UDP::respond
- Sends data directly to a
peer.
UDP::server_port
- Returns the UDP
port/service number of a server system.
UDP::unused_port
- Returns an unused
UDP port for the specified IP tuple.
